content: pmcro-reflector's Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 computes its default -QueueRoot by walking two Split-Path -Parent levels up from -PmcroRoot, which only lands correctly when -PmcroRoot is the exact relative form '.\.pmcro'. When -PmcroRoot is an absolute path, the queue item silently gets written outside the repo (observed landing at the drive root's .pmcro\queue instead of the repo's), with no error and a false status:ok/next_seed_enqueued:true. Fix the QueueRoot derivation to be robust to an absolute -PmcroRoot (e.g. derive from the already-resolved trail directory's ancestry, or require -QueueRoot explicitly), and add a check that catches this.
